test_cases.title: Appeal a declined claim by replying to the decision letter
preconditions: The member has received a decision letter declining a claim.
steps: The member replies to the decision letter to appeal the declined claim.
test_cases.expected_result: The member can appeal the declined claim by replying to the decision letter.

test_cases.title: Appeal a declined claim through the member portal
preconditions: The member has a declined claim.
steps: The member uses the member portal to appeal the declined claim.
test_cases.expected_result: The member can appeal the declined claim through the member portal.

test_cases.title: Appeal states why the decision is thought to be wrong
preconditions: The member has a declined claim.
steps: The member submits an appeal that states why they think the decision is wrong and includes no additional material.
test_cases.expected_result: The appeal states why the member thinks the decision is wrong. Additional material is not required by AC2.

test_cases.title: Appeal includes a missing referral
preconditions: The member has a declined claim and a referral that was missing from the original claim.
steps: The member submits an appeal stating why they think the decision is wrong and includes the referral.
test_cases.expected_result: The appeal states why the member thinks the decision is wrong and includes the missing referral.

test_cases.title: Appeal includes a missing pre-authorisation number
preconditions: The member has a declined claim and a pre-authorisation number that was missing from the original claim.
steps: The member submits an appeal stating why they think the decision is wrong and includes the pre-authorisation number.
test_cases.expected_result: The appeal states why the member thinks the decision is wrong and includes the missing pre-authorisation number.

test_cases.title: Appeal includes a provider description showing an accidental injury
preconditions: The member has a declined claim and a provider description showing that the injury was accidental.
steps: The member submits an appeal stating why they think the decision is wrong and includes the provider description.
test_cases.expected_result: The appeal states why the member thinks the decision is wrong and includes the provider description showing the injury was accidental.

test_cases.title: Appeal does not state why the decision is wrong
preconditions: The member has a declined claim.
steps: The member submits appeal content that does not state why they think the decision is wrong.
test_cases.expected_result: The appeal content does not satisfy AC2 because it does not state why the member thinks the decision is wrong. AC2 does not specify whether such an appeal must be blocked or how it is handled.

test_cases.title: Appeal is reviewed by a senior assessor independent of the original decision
preconditions: The member has appealed a declined claim.
A senior claims assessor who was not involved in the original decision is available to review the appeal.
steps: Have the appeal reviewed by that senior claims assessor.
test_cases.expected_result: The appeal is reviewed by a senior claims assessor who was not involved in the original decision.

test_cases.title: Original decision-maker reviews the appeal
preconditions: The member has appealed a declined claim.
The proposed reviewer was involved in the original decision.
steps: Have the proposed reviewer review the appeal and check who performed the review.
test_cases.expected_result: A review performed by the original decision-maker does not meet AC3, which requires a reviewer who was not involved in the original decision. AC3 does not specify the system's handling of this assignment.

test_cases.title: Appeal is reviewed by an assessor who is not senior
preconditions: The member has appealed a declined claim.
The proposed claims assessor is not senior.
steps: Have the proposed assessor review the appeal and check the assessor's role.
test_cases.expected_result: A review by an assessor who is not senior does not meet AC3, which requires a senior claims assessor. AC3 does not specify the system's handling of this assignment.

test_cases.title: Service dissatisfaction is handled as a complaint, not an appeal
preconditions: The member is dissatisfied with the service and is not disputing a claim decision.
steps: The member raises the service dissatisfaction.
test_cases.expected_result: The service dissatisfaction is handled as a complaint, not an appeal.
